description:
[Game reference] The ten workbench upgrades: effect, numbers and recipe. Every workbench upgrade (Accelerated, Comfort, Defensive, Efficiency, Prototype, Range, Recycle Bin,
Reinforced, Salvage, Surplus): `name`, `shortname`, `effect` in words, the exact `values` from the server files,
the `workbench` level it fits and `min_workbench`, and its `recipe`. The data on rust.wiki/workbench-upgrades.
name: get_workbench_upgrades
title: The ten workbench upgrades: effect, numbers and recipe
